title: Damage/Toxin Damage
summary: Toxin damage (bypasses shields) and DoT status.
extract:
Toxin Damage is one of the four primary elemental damage types. Toxin deals increased damage to Narmer, and ignores enemy and player Shields, but not Overguard. Its Status Effect inflicts a poisonous DoT.

Status Effects

General
The status effect of  Toxin damage is Poison. It applies a DoT effect after a 1 second delay, dealing a tick of damage every second for 6 seconds. Each tick deals  Toxin damage equal to:

Toxin Proc Damage per Tick=0.5×Modified Base Damage×(1+Toxin Damage Bonuses)×(1+Status Damage Bonuses)×(1+Faction Damage Bonuses)
Where Modified Base Damage is calculated as:

Modified Base Damage=Un-modded Weapon Damage×(1+Base Damage Bonuses)×(1+Faction Damage Bonuses)×Additional Multipliers
Base Damage Bonuses include mods like  Serration and abilities like  Vex Armor's Fury buff.
Faction Damage bonuses include mods like  Bane of Grineer and  Rhino's  Roar.
Status Damage Bonuses include mods like  Rifle Elementalist and the "Toxin Status Effects" option from  Emerald Archon Shards.
Additional Multipliers include modded critical multiplier on Critical Hit, Enemy Body Parts multipliers, Damage Type Modifiers, and Damage Vulnerability, which all stack multiplicatively with each other.
Note the lack of elemental bonuses in the Modified Base Damage formula. Mods that add  Toxin damage only apply to the Toxin Proc Damage per Tick formula, and a mod like  Magnetic Capacity has no effect on Toxin DoT damage at all.
To give a concrete example, a non-critical body shot that procs  Toxin against a  Runner from a weapon that has an innate 100  Puncture damage and that's modded with  Serration,  Infected Clip,  Rifle Elementalist, and  Bane of Infested will be cause DoT ticks that deal:

Modified Base Damage = 100 × (1 + 1.65) × (1 + 0.3) = 344.5
Toxin DoT Multiplier = (1 + 0.9) × (1 + 0.9) × (1 + 0.3) = 4.693x
Tick Damage = 0.5 × 344.5 × 4.693 = 808.3692
As can be seen in the above calculations for tick damage, Faction Damage is applied twice to Toxin ticks, making their effective bonus to tick damage equal to (1 + Faction Bonus)^2. Which is +69% for the 1.3x Faction Damage mods, and +140.25% for the 1.55x Primed Faction Damage mods.
Multiple instances of the Toxin status effect can stack on the same target, with each instance having its own timer. To preserve game performance, a maximum of 10 tick numbers are shown at once.
Enemies afflicted by a  Toxin proc have a green sickly substance leaking from their bodies.

Railjack

The status effect of  Toxin damage against Railjack space enemies is Intoxicate, changing the faction of the afflicted target for 12 seconds, allowing for friendly fire between it and normally allied units, with subsequent procs refreshing the duration.

Elemental Combinations
 Toxin +  Heat =  Gas
 Toxin +  Cold =  Viral
 Toxin +  Electricity =  Corrosive

Toxin Sources

Weapons
Main article: Category:Toxin Damage Weapons

Do also note that adversary weapons such as the  Kuva Nukor may come with a Toxin damage benefit of up to 60% as long as the progenitor matches. In this case,  Saryn would be a valid Toxin progenitor amongst others, see the progenitor list for all valid options.
